query:
UPDATE auth.users SET
                email = NULLIF($3, ''),
                phone = NULLIF($4, ''),
                email_confirmed_at = $5::timestamptz,
                phone_confirmed_at = $6::timestamptz,
                raw_app_meta_data = $7::jsonb,
                raw_user_meta_data = $8::jsonb,
                updated_at = $9::timestamptz
             WHERE instance_id = $1::uuid AND id = $2::uuid
